frame_layout.note: Indices 0-10 are coarse face points from the pose model (kept: free, and a fallback if the face block is dropped). 11-16 = shoulders, elbows, wrists. Hips and legs excluded.

Eyebrows (raise/frown), eye opening, mouth shape and head frame. R/L = signer's own right/left. Updated every 3rd frame and held in between (same rule in Python and browser). Kept in the live app only if the A4 with/without-face comparison shows it helps.

hand_slot_rule: A detected hand goes to the left_hand or right_hand slot by the nearer pose wrist (15 = signer's left wrist, 16 = signer's right wrist), using the hand's landmark 0 (wrist). MediaPipe's handedness label is stored for reference only: it assumes a mirrored selfie image and flips between frames. If both hands land on the same wrist, the closer one keeps the slot and the other takes the free slot.
missing_rule: A hand that is not detected in a frame is stored as NaN (all 63 values). A3 decides interpolation and masking; extraction never invents values.
coordinates: Normalized image coordinates as MediaPipe returns them (x, y in 0..1 of the unmirrored frame; z relative). Normalization to the body (shoulder centre, shoulder width) happens in A3 features.py, not here.
face_update_rule: Run FaceLandmarker on frames where frame_index % 3 == 0; other frames copy the last face result. If no face yet, NaN.
